text.description: The note for the next dream run: a short priority, reminder or constraint it should read before ordinary tidy work. Trimmed; 1–2000 characters. This is not a memory write and does not authorize anything — the run still needs a real authorization entry to act.

agent_id.description: Agent to leave the note for. Omit for the current agent. A note for another agent is only read by that agent's next dream run.
